question: What axial strains were applied to the NiTi wires to lock in strain on the V2O5?
trap: the <2% strain on the V2O5 itself
rendered: The axial strains applied to the NiTi wires to lock in strain on the V2O5 were 0-10%. Specifically, strains of 5% and 10% were maintained after unloading by placing the surface V2O5 film under varying mechanical strains.
